movement: A.3 strictly extends review07's third-power ordinary result and valuation-restricted supersingular product result: every ordinary surface embedding is now covered in all degrees n>=3; every supersingular rectangular product polarization has the exact all-degree parity formula; and every mixed product polarization has the exact formula in every d>=2. All complete proofs passed independent audits, with retained exact certificates and primary-source derivations. Remaining arbitrary-X and nonproduct inseparable ranks are still open.

Other-collision exclusions and uniform tangent-triple bridges remain unpromoted. No uniform higher-degree full group is counted as proved.

Corrected B37 excludes scalar residual images; B38–B40 constrain C4 and pairing orientation; B41 eliminates the entire C3/C6 branch by a proved rational3 quotient and induced9-congruence. All full proofs and exact programs passed independent root and obstruction/crystal/monodromy audits. The least index remains2 or3.
